children: State-run lender REC Ltd reported a 21.2% year-on-year fall in consolidated net profit for the September quarter to 3,477.7 crore. Consolidated interest income on loan assets rose 0.5% to 14,669.49 crore, while total income also fell marginally to 15,010.43 crore. Finance costs rose around 4.3% to 9,522 crore during the quarter. The company's loan book grew 5% sequentially reaching 6.17 lakh crore as of September 30. The renewable energy portfolio grew 27% on-year to 86,660 crore.

title: REC Q2 Profit Falls 21% to 3,477 crore
